g.text: Weak wind input is consistent with weak currents; the budget remains incomplete
Niño3.4, 0–50 m | Reconstructed monthly momentum terms | No residual is assigned to a named mechanism
Large opposing terms and unresolved contributions prevent causal percentages. Endpoint quadrature errors are saved separately.
ERA5 and SODA forcing are not independent evidence: SODA3.15.2 uses ERA5 forcing. Surface pressure loading is already included in SSH.
